The actual output shows raw input values at row 1 instead of cumulative maxima, which matches the behavior of torch.max (which returns element-wise max against an empty tensor of zeros or -inf, producing the input values) rather than cumulative max. Therefore, the first fix must replace model_new.py forward with a call to cuda_extension.cummax_forward(x, dim=0), and then ensure the custom kernel correctly computes cumulative maximum along dim=0.
